connectors.name: AEC IJ-001G-POM · two-pin socket
connectors.note: Manufacturer nominal outline: 4.90 × 3.00 mm face; 4.80 mm insulator length; 7.40 ±0.05 mm overall including solder tails. The drawing shows 0.70 mm contact bores, not a guaranteed mating pin gauge. Verify the matching plug; do not assume every 0.78 mm cable fits. Rounded corners and contact spring internals are simplified. Mounting pocket is a conservative rectangle, not a supplier retention design.
connectors.wiring: Two isolated solder tails, 1.80 mm apart. Assign input + and return to the chosen cable orientation explicitly; this drawing does not specify an audio polarity convention.

connectors.name: AEC MX-1004GT-SA0025 · MMCX edgecard socket
connectors.note: Manufacturer dimensions: 3.51 × 4.50 × 7.50 mm overall; rear contact length 3.00 mm, central tail diameter 0.70 mm. This is the specific edgecard model, not a universal IEM MMCX housing. The asymmetrical shell profile, retention spring and ground tabs remain conservatively enveloped.
connectors.wiring: Central contact is isolated from the outer shell. Map signal and return to those two conductors according to your schematic; RF impedance is not the driver impedance. Edgecard soldering and ground-tab lands need the ordered-part drawing.

driver_interfaces.note: RAF-family side terminal orientation is documented. Exact pad centres and numbering for P183 are not verified; this is a side-face harness reservation, not an exact solder endpoint.

Rear terminal strip and central vent are shown on page 1. Harness reserves a group approach to that strip, not individual pad centres. Keep the central vent clear. Page 2 states positive voltage at the marked negative terminal raises outlet pressure; do not silently equate printed polarity with acoustic phase.

guidance.title: Balanced-armature soldering
guidance.text: Knowles AN-13 specifies heat sinking and a temperature-controlled iron, recommends 1 s normal contact (3 s maximum) and 10 s cooling between joints. It suggests 30 AWG stranded hook-up wire or thinner. Insulated outside diameter must be entered separately; AWG is not cable diameter.

guidance.title: Connection structure
guidance.text: Input signal/return feed the crossover branches; each branch terminates at its driver pair. Driver series/parallel wiring and polarity are schematic decisions. A 3D harness reserves space for both conductors but does not define or override electrical nets. Multi-element receivers and MEMS need their model-specific pinout and drive circuit.

guidance.title: Sonion 2356 acoustic interface
guidance.text: The archived manufacturer drawing identifies a 6.30 × 4.29 × 2.96 mm case, 1.60 mm projecting spout with 1.40 mm outside diameter, and up to 0.64 mm rear terminal projection. Reserve the full 8.54 mm length. Do not obstruct the rear vent; tube ID must accommodate the spout plus the chosen fit allowance.
